title: Jeff Frese
intro:
Jeff Frese (Republican Party) is running for election to the U.S. House to represent California's 10th Congressional District. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the primary on June 2, 2026.
Frese completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
